content:
alice_cs: Heads-up — customer (Acme Corp) says their 30-day trial credits never showed up in the UI. They pasted the promo email id and a screenshot.
sam_eng: Can you drop the org_id and workspace_id from the support console output? quick check first.
alice_cs: org_id=org_01G8K, workspace_id shown in UI: ws_901. From the support console listing I see an extra workspace for that org: ws_qa_archive (archived). The customer says they never created that.
elaine_support: I ran the admin list: `GET /admin/orgs/org_01G8K/workspaces` -> returns ws_901 (active) and ws_qa_archive (archived, created 2023-11-02). Promo grant call returned `applied_to_workspace: ws_qa_archive`.
alice_cs: so the grant was created against the archived subproject. Customer only sees active ws_901. They were charged zero but can't consume credits. Not great.
sam_eng: Interesting — did SSO import create a duplicated subproject? We had a bug where SSO provisioning flattened service accounts into workspaces and generated `*-clone` artifacts. I will check the sync logs.
ssosync-bot: [ssosync] imported 1 identity -> created workspace ws_qa_archive (source: sso-import, actor: svc_importer)
mike_billing: If credits sit on an archived workspace, the billing UI excludes it by design. We can move credits via internal transfer API but need ops approval.
elaine_support: Customer asked for immediate fix — low severity but blocks onboarding. Requested we either move credits to ws_901 or reissue.
sam_eng: Repro steps I ran:
1) admin grant endpoint: `POST /admin/grants` with body `{ "org_id":"org_01G8K","workspace_id":"ws_qa_archive","amount":0 }` returns grant metadata (shows existing grant).
2) query grants: `SELECT id, amount, workspace_id FROM grants WHERE org_id='org_01G8K' AND workspace_id='ws_qa_archive'` -> returns grant_id g_555, amount 15000.
3) admin transfer tool accepts `POST /admin/grants/transfer` {"grant_id":"g_555","to_workspace_id":"ws_901"}
I executed transfer on staging to validate, tokens moved and customer workspace balance updated.
alice_cs: Do we need legal/billing signoff for live tenant? mikes?
mike_billing: For trial credits < $500 we can approve CS-led transfers. This is $150, so ok. I'll make a quick note in billing audit.
elaine_support: Customer gave green light — please move and confirm.
sam_eng: I'll schedule the transfer in the maintenance window (low risk). Running transfer now in prod: `POST /admin/grants/transfer` -> 202 Accepted. Monitor logs.
ssosync-bot: [audit] grant_transfer g_555 from ws_qa_archive -> ws_901 by sam_eng@redwood at 2026-03-17T15:12:05Z
sam_eng: Transfer succeeded. Confirmed workspace balance for ws_901 = 15000 tokens. Poked the customer; they can see credits now.
alice_cs: Customer confirmed they see trial balance and can start testing :party_parrot: — sending follow-up email.
mike_billing: Added audit note: billing_case #B-9802, transferred trial credits, reason: duplicate workspace created by SSO import.
sam_eng: Root cause: SSO import created an orphaned/archived workspace that matched a service account identity. Fix: dedupe logic to ignore service-account identities for workspace creation and add a safe-guard to prevent grants on archived workspaces.
sam_eng: I'll open PR to change ssosync: add check `if identity.type == \"service_account\": skip_workspace_creation()` and server-side validation on grant endpoint `reject if workspace.archived == true`.
elaine_support: Any short-term alert we can add to catch when a grant goes to an archived workspace?
sam_eng: I'll add a quick alert in the console: when admin grant created AND workspace.archived == true -> create CS task and notify #eng-oncall. PR incoming, ETA EOD.
alice_cs: Thanks everyone. Posting summary to the case notes and closing internal loop. :thumbsup:

[end of thread]
